Kneeling upright on the mattress with knees slightly parted, she slides one robe sleeve fully off her shoulder to bare more collarbone and red lace strap, gazing up through her lashes with a playful bitten-lip tease.
Twisting into a three-quarter profile on the bed, she lightly tugs the robe’s lapels wider with both hands to frame her bust, chin tilted down as a coy half-smile turns into a knowing smirk.

Sitting back on her heels in the warm cabin light, she loosens the robe’s tie completely so the satin hangs loose, one hand resting just above the lace waistband while she offers a sultry look with parted lips and a raised brow.

Reclining onto her side among the pillows, she hooks a thumb under one bra strap and eases it halfway down her arm, locking eyes with a flirtier, heavier-lidded stare that replaces the earlier soft smile.

On all fours facing the camera at a slight angle, she peels the robe off both shoulders so it pools at her elbows, catching her lower lip between her teeth in a first naughty bite while her eyes stay locked and inviting.

Lounging back against the headboard with legs loosely extended, she pulls the open robe aside with one hand and lets the other skim the edge of her lace bra cup, expression shifting to a heated smirk and half-lidded bedroom eyes.

Kneeling and arching slightly, she slips both straps of the red bra a little lower on her shoulders without removing it, looking over one shoulder with a mischievous open-mouthed tease and lifted chin.
Curled on her side with the robe draped only over one arm, she gently cups the underside of her lace-covered breast through the fabric, lips parting as her gaze turns hungrier and more direct.

Settling into a low kneel with the robe fully open and slipping off, she runs both hands slowly down her sides to the panty hips as if ready to ease them, face blooming into a bold bitten-lip stare full of promise.

current_direction.title: Midriff Tease Lift

Long dark hair remains worn down with smooth flat natural top and loose strands over her shoulders. Same sun-kissed skin tone, hourglass proportions, and recognizable body structure. Keep the soft window light, candid bedroom atmosphere, and medium-close creator framing with full head and clean space above her hair.
